children: Circle’s Arc mainnet has been live for 10 days, and its DeFi total value locked has reached $494 million. According to Odaily, the network’s TVL rose 44.52% over the past week, ranking first among major blockchains in growth rate. The network also recorded $55 million in DEX trading volume over the past 24 hours.

title: Arc Mainnet TVL Reaches $494 Million 10 Days After Launch
